name: security_alerts
title: High-risk security events are reviewed
description: When a privileged role is made to reach someone (assigned to a person or to a team, an ended assignment of one brought back into force, a person added to a team that holds one, such a team restored, or a role people hold granted its first privileged privilege), a break-glass session is approved, an API key is issued, a known person's sign-in is refused a third time in a row, or an inbound alert labelled security fires, an administrator other than the people involved reviews it and records whether it was expected. A role is privileged by what it grants, never by its name: a privilege on an operator-only resource, one whose verb reaches an action declared changes_authority, or one that writes an Accounts or Security resource (AshEnterprise.Security.Privilege.privileged?/3). Installed as drafts: nothing runs until a person publishes the process and the recipes. Every other audited write is only logged.
